title: Attenuate capability tokens without authority amplification
instruction: Harden exchange_capability(token, requested_scopes, audience, now) as a pure attenuation boundary. token must be a mapping with exact keys subject, audience, scopes, expires_at, nonce; string identifiers are non-empty, scopes is a distinct non-empty-string list, expires_at is an exact integer, and inputs are not mutated. requested_scopes is a non-empty distinct list and must be a subset of granted scopes. audience must exactly match and now must be a non-negative exact integer strictly before expiry. Reject malformed, expired, mismatched, duplicate, or amplifying requests before producing output. Return a fully detached exact-shape token preserving subject, audience, expiry, and nonce with only requested scopes. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 authorization lineage using capability attenuation, expiry, and defensive token handling.
